{"reason": "v1 paid 45000 on 34 medium/high events (1530000) yet still took 4 stockouts when alt-supplier-lead exceeded inventory-days. Alert-planner (35000, always timely) dominates supplier-switch. Alert for rank>=medium when inventory<8 (covers observed regular-leads up to 8), else monitor: stockouts 4->0, cost ~2.17M -> ~0.6M.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (< inventory-days 8))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
